name: @pipeworx/mcp-fac

tools.name: fac_search_audits
tools.description: Search US single audits (Uniform Guidance / former OMB A-133) filed with the Federal Audit Clearinghouse — "the FAC" — by auditee name, UEI, EIN, state, ZIP code, audit year, or minimum federal dollars expended. Covers every kind of non-federal recipient: cities, towns, counties, school districts, fire and water districts, housing authorities, universities, tribes, hospitals and nonprofits. Returns the report_id, summary_url (the official FAC dissemination summary page for that submission), the organization name, city, state and ZIP on file, total federal awards expended for the year, the cognizant/oversight agency, and the date FAC accepted the submission. Puerto Rico municipalities are found under either their Spanish or English legal name. Answered without a live api.data.gov key or its rate limit. Answers "does this grant recipient file a single audit and how much federal money does it run", and "what is the FAC report ID / summary URL for this entity".

auditee_name.description: Organization name, matched as a forgiving case-insensitive substring (e.g. "stanford", "county of los angeles"). A municipality name is searched in both languages FAC files under, so "MUNICIPIO DE BAYAMON" and "Municipality of Bayamon" reach the same rows. Aliases: query, q, name.

uei.description: SAM.gov Unique Entity Identifier (12 chars), exact match. Alias: auditee_uei.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, digits only, exact match. Alias: auditee_ein.

zip.description: Auditee ZIP code, matched on the 5-digit prefix so it works against both the 5-digit and 9-digit forms FAC stores ("75082", "009601588"). An auditee's ZIP on file changes between filing years; if it filters everything out the tool says which ZIPs FAC actually holds. Aliases: auditee_zip, zipcode, zip_code, postal_code.

min_total_expended.description: Only audits whose total federal awards expended is at least this many dollars (e.g. 100000000 for billion-dollar-scale recipients).

order_by.description: Sort column, descending by default. Defaults to total_amount_expended.

tools.name: fac_get_audit
tools.description: Fetch one single audit by its FAC report_id (e.g. "2025-09-GSAFAC-0000422512"), including its summary_url — the official Federal Audit Clearinghouse dissemination summary page for that report — enriched with the full federal program detail: every Assistance Listing (CFDA) number the entity expended money under, the program name, dollars expended per program, whether it was audited as a major program, and the opinion type. Also returns the auditor firm and audit findings when FAC recorded any. Does NOT return named-individual contact details (auditee/auditor contact name, email, phone) — those are not carried here; see the report's summary_url on fac.gov for that. Answers "what did this specific audit cover and what did it conclude".

report_id.description: FAC report id as returned by fac_search_audits, e.g. "2025-09-GSAFAC-0000422512". Aliases: id, audit_id.

award_limit.description: Max federal award rows to include, 1-500 (default 200).

include_findings.description: Attach audit findings for this report (default true).

tools.name: fac_audit_findings
tools.description: Audit findings recorded against single audits — the compliance exceptions, material weaknesses, significant deficiencies, questioned costs and repeat findings that auditors reported. Query by report_id, or by recipient name/UEI to sweep every audit that recipient filed. Answers "has this grant recipient had audit findings, and were they material or repeated".

report_id.description: FAC report id to pull findings for. Aliases: id, audit_id.

auditee_name.description: Recipient name substring; the tool resolves matching audits first, then their findings. Aliases: query, q, name.

uei.description: Recipient UEI; resolves that recipient's audits, then their findings. Alias: auditee_uei.

audit_year.description: Restrict the resolved audits to one audit year (used with auditee_name or uei).

include_text.description: Also attach the narrative finding text when FAC recorded any (default false — the text rows are long; a pre-2022 migrated audit often has none on file).

tools.name: fac_federal_awards_by_program
tools.description: List the organizations that expended money under a given federal Assistance Listing / CFDA number (e.g. "93.224" community health centers, "84.010" Title I, "20.205" highway planning), ranked by dollars expended, with the recipient name, state, audit year and whether it was a major program. Answers "who spends the money in this federal grant program and how much does each one run".

cfda.description: Assistance Listing / CFDA number. Accepts "93.224", "93-224", "93 224", "93224", or a bare agency prefix "93" for every program at that agency. Aliases: program_number, assistance_listing, program, cfda_number.

federal_agency_prefix.description: Two-digit agency prefix on its own, e.g. "93" for HHS. Alias: prefix.

federal_award_extension.description: Program extension on its own, e.g. "224". Alias: extension.

state.description: 2-letter recipient state code to narrow the ranking, e.g. "TX".

audit_year.description: Restrict to one audit year, e.g. 2023.

major_only.description: Keep only programs audited as major programs.

min_amount.description: Only rows expending at least this many dollars.

include_recipients.description: Resolve each report_id to the recipient name and state (default true; one extra local query).

tools.name: fac_recipient_audit_history
tools.description: Year-by-year single-audit history for one grant recipient, identified by UEI or by name. Returns each audit year with total federal awards expended, the report_id, the oversight agency and the FAC acceptance date, plus a growth read on the spend trend. Answers "how has this organization's federal funding moved over time and which years were audited".

uei.description: SAM.gov Unique Entity Identifier, the precise way to pin one recipient. Alias: auditee_uei.

auditee_name.description: Recipient name substring when the UEI is unknown, e.g. "johns hopkins". Aliases: query, q, name.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, an alternative exact identifier. Alias: auditee_ein.

state.description: 2-letter state code, useful to disambiguate a common name.

tools.name: fac_findings_search
tools.description: Full-text search over audit finding NARRATIVES — the actual prose auditors wrote describing a compliance exception ("failed to submit the Federal Single Audit report within the timeframe prescribed", "total available cash was less than total advances from grantors"). This is not possible against the live FAC API, which exposes no cross-table join; it is what searching the underlying text directly unlocks. Optionally narrow by state, audit year, CFDA agency prefix, or material-weakness-only. Narrative text is only on file for more recent filings — audits migrated from the pre-2022 Census-run FAC often have none, and rows without text are simply not returned rather than shown blank. Answers "which audits mention X in their findings", e.g. "data security", "cash management", "timesheet".

query.description: Search phrase, e.g. "data security" or "questioned costs travel". Uses PostgreSQL websearch syntax (quote a phrase, "-word" to exclude). Aliases: q, text.

state.description: 2-letter auditee state code to narrow the search, e.g. "TX".

federal_agency_prefix.description: Restrict to findings on awards under this 2-digit agency prefix (e.g. "93" for HHS). Alias: cfda_prefix.

material_weakness_only.description: Only findings flagged as a material weakness.

tools.name: fac_cross_table_screen
tools.description: Screen single audits across state, federal program (CFDA), and finding type / material weakness in ONE call — a join FAC's own live API cannot express (its PostgREST has no foreign key between /general, /federal_awards and /findings). Answers compound diligence questions like "material weaknesses in Texas under CFDA 93.224" or "questioned-cost findings on highway funding (20.205) over $1M". Every filter is optional; pass at least one to keep the result meaningful. Returns one row per matching (audit, award, finding) combination, ranked by award dollar amount.

cfda.description: Assistance Listing / CFDA number, e.g. "93.224" or a bare 2-digit agency prefix "93". Aliases: program_number, assistance_listing, program, cfda_number.

federal_agency_prefix.description: Two-digit agency prefix on its own. Alias: prefix.

federal_award_extension.description: Program extension on its own, e.g. "224". Alias: extension.

finding_type.description: Substring match on FAC's finding type_requirement code (e.g. "A" internal control, "B" allowable costs — FAC packs several letters into one field, so this matches loosely).

material_weakness_only.description: Only findings flagged as a material weakness.

min_amount.description: Only award rows expending at least this many dollars.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fac forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fac pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
